context.help: Compact and recall context items assembled by the engine.
context.compact.help: Compact the items in a JSON file and print the result and the report.
context.recall.help: Print the archived original of an elided item.
context.arg.items_file: JSON file with a list of items (or an object with an 'items' list).
context.arg.budget: Token budget. Defaults to context.budget_tokens from the configuration.
context.arg.archive_dir: Directory where original texts are archived.
context.stub.archived: [tool output {id} elided: about {tokens} tokens archived at {ref}; recall it by id '{id}']
context.stub.unarchived: [tool output {id} elided: about {tokens} tokens, not archived because no archive directory is set]
context.stage2.no_summarizer: Summarization was skipped: no summarizer is configured.
context.stage2.nothing_to_summarize: Summarization was skipped: no unpinned, non-recent items are left to summarize.
context.stage2.summarizer_failed: Summarization was skipped: the summarizer failed ({error}). The items were left unchanged.
context.stage2.summary_not_smaller: Summarization was skipped: the summary was not smaller than the items it would replace.
